title: Paper Airplane
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office participates in a branch-wide paper airplane contest sponsored by Weyer-Hammer Paper with a $2,000 prize. Dwight ultimately wins the contest after a series of competitive rounds, including a final where both he and Angela fake throws. Meanwhile, Angela struggles with financial difficulties following her separation from the Senator and reflects on her past with Dwight. Jim and Pam discuss their couple's therapy and reaffirm their love amidst minor interruptions. Andy prepares for a film role involving chemical safety protocols but struggles emotionally with a challenging scene. Erin reveals her competitive side and frustration after losing in the contest. The episode explores themes of competition, personal growth, and relationships within the office.
